items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: He had all the Scott Joplin and music sheets. And that’s how I started playing.

ctx.x: And I understand he was a musician as well, or at least a jazz fan?

Yeah, well he was an incredible jazz fan and record collector. And he belonged to a record club in Tulsa, a bunch of record collectors. And to relax he played ragtime. He had all the Scott Joplin and music sheets. And that’s how I started playing. My first gig was accompanying my father on that wood block.
Now tell me about, there’s this rumor going around that you borrowed someone’s hubcap to make a cymbal. Is that true?
